items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: we did see the movie “Sun Valley Serenade,” which had Glenn Miller, “Chattanooga Choo Choo” and all of that

ctx.x: Why did you already know this music before you got to Hamilton?

Okay. I grew up from the age of 10 outside of Stockholm, Sweden. And I came to the United States when I was 17. So I lived in Sweden between the age of 10 and 17. And when we were 15 or 16, a number of us started getting interested in — well it was during the war, so not too much was coming into Sweden, but we did see the movie “Sun Valley Serenade,” which had Glenn Miller, “Chattanooga Choo Choo” and all of that, and “In the Mood.” And so we were excited by that, and we could get the Joe Loss recording of “In…
